dialog.disclaimer_content:
This module injects code into system processes, which is an unofficial change. You may get:

- Keys that stop working, features that misbehave
- In the worst case, a device that cannot boot

By continuing you confirm that you understand this and **take the risk yourself**.
dialog.command_disclaimer_content:
Custom commands are a **high-risk** feature.

This module **does not validate or protect anything you enter**.

Please make sure the commands are safe and accept the consequences yourself.
dialog.free_notice_content: This module is **completely free** and no feature will ever cost anything. Please make sure you are using the **official release**.
